item.title: Blueprints for Awakening
item.description:
Blueprints for Awakening Premananda

Source: TW

Author: Premananda

Visit Premananda ’s website.

Purchase ‘Blueprints for Awakening’ direct from the publisher, from Amazon.com
or from Amazon.UK.

Link to entry on Current Teacher’s page

‘Blueprints for Awakening’ is a beautifully produced book (including color photographs) in which Premananda visits 16 modern Indian gurus and asks them the same questions, based upon Ramana Maharshi’s booklets ‘Who Am I?’ and ‘Self Enquiry’. In this way, a number of key issues are addressed from different angles increasing the likelihood of clarification in the mind of the reader. A brilliant idea, brilliantly realized! There is also a DVD available in which all of the teachers take part, answering a few of the questions contained in the book. Although this only acts as a ’taster’, prompting you to buy the book, the presence, wisdom and humor of the sages shines out through the screen. See my review of the book.
